challenges.description: Driver applications, document reviews, approvals, and onboarding actions needed a structured, centralized process.

challenges.title: Time-sensitive communication
challenges.description: Special delivery opportunities required fast notifications and direct communication with available drivers.

challenges.title: Complicated payroll and settlements

challenges.title: Operational visibility
challenges.description: Management needed a clearer view of progress, assignments, contractor activities, and operational issues.

overview: Expedited Transport Services needed one place to coordinate contractors, assign routes, handle special deliveries and manage driver payments.

BytechSol brought these workflows into CMJL: a web platform for operations staff, supported by iOS and Android driver apps. Contractor records, dispatch, communication, payroll and settlements share one operational foundation.
solution: CMJL connects a web operations platform with dedicated driver apps. Staff can review contractors, assign delivery work, communicate with drivers and manage compensation. The mobile apps connect contractors to the same delivery ecosystem.
integration: The project also included detailed analysis of a direct OnTrac integration. At the time of the documented review, route intake depended on selecting and exporting carrier data into files, then importing those files into Expedited’s system.

A phased technical proposal investigated read-only route, manifest, assignment, reference-code, and change data access. A separately approved future phase would return delivery events and proof of delivery to OnTrac with validation, retry, audit, and reconciliation controls.

OptimoRoute-based route analysis was also being implemented to explore planned-versus-actual activity, distance, time, and service outcomes. Direct OnTrac API connectivity remained proposed, while OptimoRoute analysis was in implementation in September 2026; neither should be represented as a verified completed production integration.
approach: Centralization: Bring operational tasks into one management environment.
Operational efficiency: Structure route intake, assignments, communication, and compensation workflows.
Driver experience: Support contractors through mobile applications, communications, and payment features.
Scalability: Design for additional contractors, delivery work, integrations, and reporting.
impact: Centralized management of contractor applications, dispatch, special orders, communications, and financial workflows.
More structured driver coordination through Driver Pool, alerts, calling, and chat.
More connected compensation administration through payroll, settlements, and Early Payout.
A management dashboard for operational monitoring and oversight.
A web and mobile ecosystem connecting dispatch staff with contractor-facing applications.
These are documented capabilities and intended operational benefits. Quantified cost savings, delivery-time improvements, or revenue increases have not been independently verified.
result: CMJL brings contractor management, dispatch, communication and compensation into one web and mobile platform. It gives the operations team a connected view of daily work and a foundation for further automation.
